content: संस्कृ €8 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To adorn, grace, decorate; ककुभं समस्कुरुत माघवनीम् <ls>Śi. 9. 25</ls>. .²2 To refine, polish; वाण्येका समलंकरोति पुरुषं या संस्कृता धार्यते <ls>Bh. 2. 19</ls>; <ls>Śi. 14. 50</ls>. .²3 To consecrate by repeating Mantras; मन्त्रैस्तु संस्कृतानद्याच्छाश्वतं विधिमास्थितः <ls>Ms. 5. 36</ls>. .²4 To purify (a person) by scriptural ceremonies, perform purificatory ceremonies over (a person); संचस्कारोभयप्रीत्या मैथिलेयौ यथाविधि <ls>R. 15. 31</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 124</ls>. .²5 To cultivate, educate, train; आर्योपदेशसंस्क्रियमाणमतयः <ls>Mu. 3</ls>. .²6 To make ready, prepare, equip, fit out; जीवां भूयो रघुपतिवृषा स्पर्शतः संस्करोति <ls>Mv. 6. 37</ls>; <ls>Ms. 9. 279</ls>; <ls>Mu. 3</ls>. .²7 To cook, dress (food). .²8 To purify, cleanse. .²9 To collect, heap together. .²10 To construct, form well or thoroughly. .²11 To accumulate; ये पक्षापरपक्षदोषसहिताः पापानि संस्कुर्वते <ls>Mk. 9. 4</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>). .²12 To correct (astronomically).
